title: Bandage a sprained wrist in figure-of-eight turns, passing the roll hand to hand under the arm
instruction: Bandage the sprained wrist with the crepe bandage in figure-of-eight turns, fasten its end, then let go.
context: Wrapping a sprained wrist with an elastic crepe bandage is standard first aid (St John Ambulance, Red Cross) done at home, in schools and at sports events. Wrist turns anchor the end, then figure-of-eight loops cross on the back of the hand, rounding under the palm and back under the wrist. Because the arm is supported, the roll must pass hand to hand under the arm on every turn while keeping the wrap taut so it does not unwind, then fasten by its hook patch.
setup: cm from arm-base midpoint (x fwd, y left), z above table. Rigid right forearm-and-hand form, palm down, thumb left, clamped at (9,0) with 20 cm white scale bar at x 14.5: elbow x 5, wrist x 29, +x on y 0, 16 up, clear below; forearm 6.6-5.7 dia, palm 10.5x8.5x2.8 (x 29.5-40), fingers 7.5x7.6x1.8 (x 39.5-47), thumb 6.5x2.1; flush TPU cuffs on wrist (x 20-28) & palm (x 31-39.5) to mmHg sensors. Coreless 3M ACE 7.5 cm x 1.66 m wrap, 4 cm hook patch; 4.0 cm roll at (24,13), end to (24,-8.2).
scoring: 0 if <1 wrist turn (x<30 cm) before diagonals. Else 0.25: 1+ wrist turn before diagonals; 0.5: + 1 figure-of-eight loop (up diag >=3 cm, palm x>33.5 cm, crossing down diag, wrist x<30 cm); 0.75: + 2nd loop, thumb (>=5 mm past 40%) & 3 cm tips (>=10 mm) bare, all 1.66 m unwound off roll in 6.0-9.0 total turns, no part >1 cm off skin/wrap, wrist & palm cuffs both 12.0-55.0 mmHg; 1.0: + 4 cm hook patch fastened, jaws >5 cm, >=10 cm clear, <2 cm/s with cuffs 12.0-55.0 mmHg for 1 s.
reset_notes: Peel off the hook patch, tare both wrist and palm cuff pressure sensors to 0.0 mmHg on the bare form, lay the 1.66 m bandage flat unstretched against a 2 m rule verifying its 20.0 cm reset ticks (20.0 +/- 0.3 cm), fold the stiff 4 cm inner hook patch inward (~14 mm coreless centre) and wind 1.46 m unstretched to a 4.0 +/- 0.2 cm roll leaving 20.0 cm free; set roll at (24,13) cm, axis +x, outer end flat along -y to (24,-8.2) cm.
fidelity: Bandage: PBD strip (3 cols across 7.5 cm, 2 cm stations) unwinding off coreless roll past 1.42x pull (up to 2.47x under >3.5 mm jaw clamp); applies pull (6 N/strain) + roll weight onto gripper in PhysX. Contacts lay while taut (>=1.05x); unheld unfastened wrap recoils at 40 cm/s. Two-pad contact grasps (+8/+10 mm release). Final 4 cm hook patch latches under >=1.5 mm compression 0.25 s. Cuff mmHg integrated by Laplace hoop pressure (10 N/strain) over laid plies; approximate, no soft tissue.
